reason: An external-service provider plugin that integrates Command Code LLM accounts into DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, settings, usage reporting, account rotation, reasoning controls, and vision-model image input.

summaries.zh: 将 Command Code 的大语言模型、模型目录、账户用量和多账户轮换功能集成到 DeepSeek Harness 中。
summaries.en: Integrates Command Code language models into DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, account usage reporting, multi-account rotation, and vision-model image input.

capabilities: Connects to the Command Code API for LLM requests
Reads and manages Command Code API key references
Fetches a live model catalog and account usage information
Supports image input for vision-capable models
Provides multi-account rotation when usage limits are reached
